description: This file initializes and renders the React application by attaching the main App component to the DOM element with id 'root'. It also includes essential imports for React, ReactDOM, styling, and the main App component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the DOM within the created root.
